stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-b4cea251.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored diagonals encode a repeating sequence along the toroidal grid.
    # Recover the sequence from the nonzero cells by their diagonal phase.
    seq = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v:
                phase=(c-r)%w
                if phase >= len(seq):
                    seq.extend([None]*(phase+1-len(seq)))
                seq[phase]=v
    # Each diagonal stripe marks the same sequence, so extend the phase cycle.
    # Infer period from the observed phase values, filling missing phases using repeats.
    vals=[v for v in seq if v is not None]
    # Select the shortest cyclic word that matches all observed diagonal values.
    n=len(seq)
    period=n
    for p in range(1,n+1):
        if all(seq[i] is None or seq[i]==seq[i%p] for i in range(n) if i%p < len(seq)):
            period=p; break
    word=[]
    for i in range(period):
        word.append(seq[i] if i<len(seq) and seq[i] is not None else 0)
    return [[word[(c-r)%period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
''')
print(p.read_text())
